names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed localized given names and surnames. Gender grouping is a review seed and is not an official civil registry export.

source.title: ITU Congo national numbering plan communication of 1.XI.2024

phones.notes: ITU/ARPCE confirms country code +242, nine-digit national significant numbers and recent mobile Voice/SMS/Data assignments in the 06 range. Public numbering references list 01, 04, 05 and 06 as mobile prefixes; generated numbers are synthetic and not checked for current subscriber assignment or portability.

locations.notes: City address records are map-reference samples of public places checked on 2026-07-31. postalCode is copied only when the map source provides one; PO Box and Plus Code values are not used as postalCode. The location block source gives country-level address context; each address record carries its own map source.

national_identity_card_number.label: National Identity Card

source.title: IRB Canada: Republic of the Congo national identity card

national_identity_card_number.notes: The public response describes the CNI followed by a personal identification number on the card, but does not confirm a current public number length, checksum or semantic digit rule. Template includes CNI as a document-family marker and random digits only.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Republic of the Congo ordinary passport document entries

passport.notes: PRADO confirms ordinary passport entries for the Republic of the Congo. The public listing does not confirm passport-number grammar, so generation remains template-only synthetic.
